title: Warm Buttery French Cream Choux Pastry
description: A buttery, crispy, romantic French dessert featuring whipping cream and coconut cream, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Combine the water, milk, and butter in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil.
Add the flour to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let cool for 5 minutes.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, until the mixture is smooth.
Transfer the mixture to a piping bag fitted with a large round tip.
Pipe the mixture onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Allow the pastry to cool for 5 minutes, then split in half lengthwise.
Fill the pastry with whipping cream and coconut cream.
Sprinkle with granulated sugar and serve immediately.
